dialogs.about: 내일 등산 갈 준비로 배낭을 싸며 할아버지와 이야기

lines.en: Are we going to hike tomorrow?
Yes, we will hike the mountain trail.
I am putting water in the backpack.
Please put my old walking stick inside.
lines.ko: 제 오래된 지팡이도 안에 넣어 주세요.

lines.en: Okay, your stick is inside. Is the trail steep?
lines.ko: 네, 지팡이는 안에 있어요. 산길은 가파른가요?

lines.en: One part is steep, but the view is scenic.
Last year I was breathless near the summit.
We will rest often and walk slowly.
lines.ko: 우리 자주 쉬고 천천히 걸을 거예요.

lines.en: Did you sweat a lot on that day?
Yes, I did. The fresh air felt wonderful then.
lines.ko: 네, 그랬어요. 그때 맑은 공기가 참 좋았어요.

dialogs.about: 산길 중턱 의자에서 쉬다가 만난 등산객과 이야기

lines.en: Hello. Is this the trail to the summit?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 길이 정상으로 가는 산길인가요?

lines.en: Yes, it is. The summit is one hour away.
lines.ko: 네, 맞아요. 정상까지 한 시간 걸려요.

lines.en: Thank you. Is the path steep up there?
It's steep, but the view up there is scenic.
Your backpack looks heavy. Are you tired?
A little. I am resting on this bench.
I hiked here last week with my son.
I am sweating and a little breathless today.
lines.ko: 오늘은 땀도 나고 숨도 조금 차요.

lines.en: Rest well. I will walk slowly too.
Thank you. Have a safe hike!
